title: Jijel night marches against curfew extension — boundary review only
location: Jijel city streets, including areas by the wilaya seat and central routes

related_prior_unit_sources.use_note: Prior-unit body metadata consulted for boundary review only; not a fresh retrieval or independent corroboration.

start_date.summary: ObservAlgérie dates two nights to January 30 and 31; the January Twala source card records January 30 as the first reported night.

current_unit_activity_date.summary: The opened February 1 article dates the two nights to January 30 and 31 and reports no February action. This does not establish that no other February action occurred.

participants_original.summary: The local reports say several dozen/dozens; neither supplies a precise number or a clear lower bound of 50.

end_date.summary: Neither saved body describes a physical dissolution or certain episode end; end remains unknown.

notes: Boundary-review lead only, not a coded February continuation. ObservAlgérie body says the two nights were January 30 and 31 and describes several dozen people; it does not provide a February date or physical end. Prior-unit Le Monde describes hundreds over consecutive nights, while the Le Jeune Indépendant three-day duration remains search-only; preserve these differences and source roles. The Twala card S085 is copied from the January dossier with the original access time and reader identified; it was not freshly retrieved. A February 2 Le360 search-only boundary article (S103) also recounts the late-January actions but supplies no new February physical date; it is not opened evidence.
open_questions: Did any physical action occur on February 1 or later as part of this local episode?
Do the two-night and three-day accounts refer to the same episode, and what was its physical end?
Does the episode as a whole meet the 50-person threshold without assigning a count to each night?

start_date.summary: The prior-unit opened SIWEL article, represented in this unit by dossier-consultation card S130 (January source S037, web ref turn65view0), dates a street march to December 26; it does not establish the first campaign date.

current_unit_activity_date.summary: Search-only February items report work returning after the Jan31 assembly/cancellation of technical unemployment and later supply concerns. They do not establish a public gathering in February; no current-unit activity date is assigned.

end_date.summary: Work resumption is not a documented physical dissolution of the prior public march or a public protest ending; end remains unknown.

participants_original.summary: No February public-gathering attendance is reported. Workforce totals such as 1,700 are not march attendance.

continuity.summary: The reports describe return to work after cancellation of the technical-unemployment decision, not an uninterrupted public assembly.

notes: Boundary-only review; no February ENIEM public assembly is established by these search-only items, which does not prove none occurred. Q014 newspaper/press previews report that the factory work resumed February 1 after a Jan31 general assembly and cancellation of technical unemployment. A planned or actual return to work is not an event end. The VAVA Jan31 result is the same URL as prior-unit S045; radio and Algerie Eco reports rely on APS/El Watan, not independent confirmation. Prior reports' 1600/1700 figures are worker counts, not public turnout.
open_questions: Was any public march/sit-in held at ENIEM after February 1?
Did the public-action episode physically end, and when?
Which February work-resumption reports share the same APS/El Watan written origin?
